column1: # Every decision in DECISIONS.md has a test, or says why it has none (decisions.py; check.sh runs it).
# Decisions with cases tagged D<n> in rules.tsv, telex_simple*.tsv or reported.tsv need no row here.
#   test: the tests that lock it, as path::text found in that file (repo-relative), separated by " ; "
#   none: no typing behavior to test (process, website, rejected or not built)
#   open: behavior without an automated test yet (counted; the scorecard shows them)

column3: Mac event tap that stops until a restart: app-level (VikeyCore.mm), needs a live Mac test
process: which parts of upstream PR #333 to take
per-website language memory: Mac app-level (off by default since D15)
typing log opt-in and the About window: settings UI, no typing behavior
per-site memory off by default, (?) help on every option: app settings defaults
auto update (Sparkle): checked by hand on each release
pause auto switch 5 s after a manual switch: app-level timer on each platform (Mac, Windows, Linux, Android)
process: tuning set vs locked test set
Linux pre-edit in apps that never report the surrounding text: needs a live Linux test
custom keyboard layouts and the per-keyboard switch: Mac app-level (VikeyCore.mm, MainView), needs a live Mac test
